answer: Identities sharing a funding source form one cluster whose total epoch payout is capped at 50 POA, split equally among its members, and each identity pays a 5 POA activation fee. A lone honest identity keeps its full share, like one tree in a grove, while 100 fakes from one wallet split the same 50 POA into 0.5 each and pay 500 in fees, a canyon between profit and loss that widens with every extra fake. Funding links and payout splits are on-chain, so any verifier replays the cluster graph and checks the cap, while juniper roots of honest funding stay separate and cheap.
